decisions.reason: 어? is a startled recognition; Huh? matches that beat, while Wait? adds a pause-and-rethink the Korean does not use.
지금이라도 is even now / at the very least now, especially after 이미 늦었다; before it was too late reverses that timing.
그건 또 어디서 is an exasperated spoken follow-up; And where… carries the additive 또 more naturally than a tagged-on too.
후우우웅’s 웅 is a resonant whoom of gathering energy, not a wind whoosh, and it should not duplicate 화아아악.
Same 살날이 얼마 남지 않은 meaning, without BASE’s stacked no longer… who did not negation.
천륜(天倫) is the sacred/heaven-ordained kinship ethic; dropping sacred flattens Jeok Cheongang’s accusation.
화아아악 is a fire-rush blast; Fwoooosh matches 화 and keeps it distinct from 후우우웅.
파공음 is air splitting, not a roar; roar also collides with the 포효 in P82 and the later 굉음.
BASE’s young man—Jin Taekyung’s—condition is broken English; SOL’s cut him off turns 가로막은 from blocking his approach into speech interruption.
decisions.replacement: Jang Taebo burst out in frustration and was just about to check on the young man, Jin Taekyung, when a clear voice stopped him.

decisions.reason: 이런 빌어먹을 늙은이를 봤나 is the rhetorical have you ever seen such a damned old man; BASE invents what’s wrong with and old bastard.
